items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Do you recall any of those books?

It was some piano books, stuff that wasn’t fixation in terms of the chordal picture, you weren’t locked into that. So I had to do it my way; like Billy Eckstine says, “My Way.” “My Way”, Frank did that, so I’m in with the guys (laughs).
We had a guy in Philly, when they talk about Cecil, Hassan.
